posts.text: Day 2 Canada Life at #HackWestern: Student Coffee Chats (with Karen Hatherell) ✅️ Networking booth (with Jenny Jarvis and Stephani LaPierre )✅️ A great panel on Women in technology (with Amber Bird Julie Fraser Susan Binning. Hosted by Vaishak Nair ) ✅️ And a visit by #HackCat! ✅️ What a weekend so far! Thanks to everyone for making it happen! #MyCanadaLife
And we are up and ready to go at #HackWestern13! We are looking forward to meet up with Hackers this weekend. This evening, stop by and share your GTA 6 tips with David Ticknor .

I work with some pretty awesome people. This week, members of our London HR team, along with other Canada Life colleagues, had the opportunity to spend time volunteering at the London Food Bank, supporting an organization that makes a meaningful difference for so many individuals and families in our community.
